question: How many executive orders will the US president sign during December 2026?

calls.reasoning: Reference class: Trump monthly EO counts in 2026 (median ~6-7, range 2-11). The pace has slowed. The Federal Register shows 4 EOs in October (the last on Oct 22). None appears to have been signed Nov 1-18: the Nov 5 'Oval Office' signing was reported as a proclamation. December 2025 had about 8-10 EOs. December usually brings routine orders, such as the annual pay-rate adjustment and the holiday closures of executive departments, which sets a floor around 1-2. The holiday period and the post-midterm lull pull the count down; year-end pushes and a lame-duck agenda could push it up. Market check: none found on Polymarket, Manifold or Kalshi. Some December orders may not be published in the Federal Register until January, but they still count once published.
